review.tagline: 12-week, 26-lesson classic machine learning course using Scikit-learn
review.summary: A Microsoft Cloud Advocates curriculum covering classic machine learning (regression, classification, clustering, NLP) with Scikit-learn, deliberately excluding deep learning. Each lesson has pre- and post-lecture quizzes, a written lesson, a solution, a challenge and an assignment, built around datasets from different world regions. Lessons are in Python, with R Markdown versions for many.
review.audience: Beginners and teachers learning classic machine learning with Python
strengths: Project-based lessons with solutions in /solution folders and quizzes for each lesson
Many lessons also provided in R as .rmd files
Translated into 50+ languages via automated GitHub Action
MIT license; can run in GitHub Codespaces without local Python setup
weaknesses: Covers classic ML only; deep learning is in a separate curriculum
Not about LLMs or generative AI
Clone is large because of 50+ translations unless sparse checkout is used
Per-lesson dependencies must be installed manually
